item.title: Cabaletta Autoimmune CAR-T
item.description:
• Summary: Cabaletta Bio is a key player in the autoimmune CAR-T space, developing chimeric antigen receptor T-cell therapies for autoimmune diseases such as lupus and myositis. The company is focused on demonstrating durability of its therapies and business model, aiming to provide long-term remission for patients with B cell-driven autoimmune disorders.
  • MoAs: Chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T-cell therapy targeting CD19 on B cells to eliminate autoreactive B cells.
  • Sources: Fierce Biotech
